exposure: Thickness of the myometrium at the uterine scar
maximum diameter of the gestational sac
thickness of the myometrium at the uterine scar
Maximum diameter of the gestational sac
outcome: Risk factors associated with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 208 patients with CSP admitted to the People's Hospital of Leshan between January 2018 and December 2022
finding: A clinical prediction model based on time of menstrual cessation, maximum diameter of the gestational sac, thickness of the myometrium at the uterine scar, pre-treatment blood HCG levels, and grade of blood flow signals can effectively predict the risk of hemorrhage in patients with CSP.
